items.title: Strengthening Target-Language Features: SAE-Based Steering for Multilingual Inference
items.abstract: Multilingual large language models exhibit substantial performance differences across languages, while existing adaptation methods often require parameter updates and considerable multilingual training data. We propose an inference-time multilingual steering method that uses pretrained sparse autoencoders to identify and strengthen target-language-related features. Using multilingual parallel sentences, we compare SAE activations across languages and select a small number of layer-specific features associated with each target language. These features are decoded into steering signals and injected into the model's hidden states without additional training. Experiments with Gemma-3-12B-it show average accuracy improvements of 10.9 percentage points on XCOPA, 5.3 points on XNLI, and 1.9 points on MGSM.

items.llm_tldr_en: This paper proposes an inference-time steering method that uses pretrained sparse autoencoders to identify language-specific features, decodes them into steering vectors, and injects them into a multilingual LLM's hidden states to strengthen target-language performance without any parameter updates.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 本文提出一种推理时的多语言引导方法，利用预训练稀疏自编码器识别与目标语言相关的特征，将其解码为引导信号注入模型隐藏状态，从而在不更新参数的前提下显著提升多语言大模型在目标语言上的推理准确率，验证了特征级向量干预对语言模型行为的可控性。
